name: opencode-config
description: OpenCode configuration toolkit — agents, MCP servers, Python modules for multimodal AI workflows

scripts.install: cd .. && pip3 install -e opencode_media -e opencode_video -e opencode_web -e opencode_display 2>/dev/null; echo 'Python packages installed'
scripts.postinstall: npx playwright install chromium 2>/dev/null || echo 'Playwright browsers: install manually with: npx playwright install chromium'
scripts.verify: python3 -c 'from opencode_media import process_file; print("opencode_media OK")'
